messages:
marta: Thanks everyone for joining the all-hands—leaving an open thread for follow-ups on the inference roadmap, especially runtime perf, batching/caching, and kernel work. Ask specific questions here and I'll try to get leads to respond. :raised_hands:

devon: Quick clarifying q — are we locking the kernel prioritization roadmap today? e.g., fused-attn -> fused-mha -> microbatcher?

sara: Also curious about KV cache eviction policy. How will eviction interact with continuous batching? Any plan to expose eviction controls per-customer?

lee: From product: what's the user-visible rollout schedule? Customers ask about latency improvements ETA.

marta: Short version: not 'locked' but staged. High-level plan: 1) fused-attn kernels (low-level perf, Q2), 2) microbatching & prewarm improvements (reduces p95/backpressure, late Q2->Q3), 3) KV cache policy + smarter prefix caching (Q3). We'll keep quantized model fallbacks for cost-sensitive tiers. We'll publish the timeline after engineering sync tomorrow.

devon: Technical note — continuous batching work is focused on lowering lock contention and reducing max_wait. Config prototype (will iterate):

```yaml
batch_policy: continuous
max_batch_ms: 10
batch_size_target: 64
allow_microbatching: true
```

devon: That config reduces tail but trades some cost. We'll add adaptive knobs to tune per-workload.

sara: For canaries, what metrics will gate rollout? My suggested list: p95 latency, p99 stalls (kv cache misses), token cost delta, and automated quality checks on a small eval set.

noah: From SRE — +1 on p99 and also need trace-level tags to map requests to kernel variant. Can we add per-model kernel_version tag to traces and per-route latency breakdown in the console?

marta: Yes. Assigning to eng-sre to add kernel_version and route tags. We'll include a short tracing guide in the release notes.

opsbot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: canary/runtime-kernels/v3 -> us-east-1 (2026-04-01T15:23:10Z)

ben: Quick ask — embeddings path still suffering higher tail. Can we separate embedding exec path so batching there doesn't interfere with chat generation? 

devon: Embeddings will be routed to a separate execution pool by default, planned Q2 end. We'll add a small LRU cache for popular vectors as an interim.

maya: Customer success note — customers expect clear comms. Can we get a short KB and a customer-facing latency matrix when the canary hits staging?

marta: Yep — we'll publish a KB and a one-page latency matrix. Ping me if you want early access. I'll update this thread after tomorrow's eng sync with concrete PRs and owners. :rocket:
